fields.description: Program Description Program overview Master in IBM based on teaching and research, complemented with practical application of learning during an internship period. Master in IBM was designed especially for international students who are interested in corporate management or international trade where business interaction with China is involved. Key modules: Profile of China, Basic Chinese, Chinese Economics and Political Regime, Econometrics, Strategy Management, Research Method, Management Information System, Microeconomics, Organizational Behavior etc. Tuition and Program Fee 35,000 RMB for one academic year.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Copies of Bachelor diplomas and certificates Degree certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 2. Official University transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 3. Non-criminal Certificate * 4. English language proficiency certificate * 5. Two recommendation letters by professors or associate professors Written in English from two professors or associate professors, including professors' contact information, email address and handwritten signature. * 6. Deposit Certificate * 7. Study plan * 8. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity). * 9. 1-inch photo * 10. Passport page of Chinese visa as well as stamp and signature if you have been to China before, if not, passport blank page(four corners complete). 11. Curriculum Vitae(if already finish latest studying career more than 2 years). 12. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 16 years old and above. Successful completion of bachelor degree with good grades and full transcripts. IELTS 5.5(with a minimum of 5.0 in all subskills) or equivalent.
